dsh-vista
Visual memory and active inspection for DeepSeek Harness.
English · 中文
# English
> Your agent sees an image once. dsh-vista makes it addressable forever.

DSH agents work with screenshots, charts, and rendered pages, but the image that
matters is often go

ne after the next tool call or compaction. dsh-vista keeps
every image it has seen in an addressable

archive and gives the agent a visual
history plus active inspection and persistent task memory:

* — recover prior turns, frames, and stable ids;
- **`GUIDE.md` / `WORKING.md`** — keep durable know

ledge and compact-handoff
state across context boundaries.
Every image that reaches the model is automatically tagged with a stable id:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The model can reference `v12` later even if the original image has fallen out of
the context window.
## Based on VISTA

dsh-vista is an adaptation of **VISTA: A Visual Harness for Reasoning in an
Interactive World** by Q

iushi Han, Keya Hu, Linlu Qiu, Cathy Wu, and Kaiming He
(MIT):

- Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02200
- Code: https://github.com/joshhhhhan/VISTA

It brings VISTA's core ideas — lossless visual memory, active visual inspection,
and exact pixel rea

ding — into DeepSeek Harness. It is not the official VISTA
implementation; it is a DSH-native adapta

— into DeepSeek Harness. It is not the official VISTA
implementation; it is a DSH-native adaptation.
## Why

- **Compaction drops bytes, not meaning.** dsh-vista keeps the original bytes
addressable after the

context has moved on.
- **Re-screenshotting is expensive and lossy.** The screen has changed; the
im

age you need is the one from three steps ago.
- **"Look at the whole image again" is not inspection.

** A good visual agent
asks a specific question about a specific region.
- **Text-only fallback.** `

read_pixels` works even when the model route accepts
text only.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does | Output |
| `inspect` | Select an archived `visual` and an optional region; crops from the original and enlarg

es with nearest-neighbour. | Image blocks |
| `read_pixels` | Divide a region into equal rows and co

lumns; sample each centre pixel. | Palette + symbol rows |
| `visuals` | List recent visuals with id

, source, size, and timestamp. | JSON |
| `history` | List visual-bearing events and their ordered t

urn/frame references. | JSON |
| `register_image` | Archive an explicit local path that was not capt

ured automatically. | JSON |
| `read_guide` / `write_guide` | Read or replace durable workspace-scop

ed visual knowledge. | Text / status |
| `read_working` / `write_working` | Read or replace temporar

y continuation state. | Text / status |
| `save_compact_checkpoint` | Save WORKING and optionally re
place GUIDE before a context handoff. | Status |

`read_pixels` only measures. It does not align, transform, or interpret pixels.
## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The archive is content-addressed and append-only (`index.jsonl` plus files under
`archiveDir`). DSH'

s attachment service still owns the image that reaches the
model; dsh-vista keeps a second copy so v

isual ids survive compaction and image
offload.
## Configuration

Defaults live in `src/config.ts`. Override them in the bundle row or the
profile patch:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Field | Default | Meaning |

| `archiveDir` | `$DSH_HOME/dsh-vista/archive` | Byte store and `index.jsonl`. |
| `displaySize` | `

1024` | Longest edge of an inspected crop. |
| `maxInspectViews` | `16` | Views per `inspect` call.

|
| `maxPixelViews` | `64` | Views per `read_pixels` call. |
| `maxPixelSamples` | `4096` | Total sa

mples per `read_pixels` call. |
| `annotate` | `true` | Insert `<visual id="...">` before every arch

ived image. |
| `retentionDays` | `7` | Delete older archived visuals; `0` keeps forever. |
## What this deliberately does not do

- No environment adapters (ARC-AGI-3, GameWorld, browser automation).
- No `play` / `act` action too

ls.
- No one-action-per-turn policy, budgets, or evaluation harness.
- No Python sidecar.

Those belong in follow-up plugins. This one answers a narrower question: does
addressable visual mem

ory plus active inspection improve a DSH agent's visual
work?

# 中文
> 你的 agent 只见过一张图一次，dsh-vista 让它永久可寻址。
DSH agent 经常要处理截图、图表和渲染后的页面，但真正重要的那张图，往往在下一次工具调用或上下文压缩之后就消失了。dsh-vista 会把 agent 见过的每一张图保存进一个可寻址的归档，并
提供 turn/frame 历史、主动检视与持久任务记忆：

- **`inspect`** —— 重新查看任意历史图像并裁剪任意区域，以无平滑插值的方式放大；
- **`read_pixels`** —— 把某个区域采样成紧凑的符号矩阵，读取精确颜色；
- *

*`history` / `visuals`** —— 找回历史 turn、frame 与稳定 id；
- **`GUIDE.md` / `WORKING.md`** —— 跨上下文边界保存长期知识和

tory` / `visuals`** —— 找回历史 turn、frame 与稳定 id；
- **`GUIDE.md` / `WORKING.md`** —— 跨上下文边界保存长期知识和续跑状态。
每一张送到模型面前的图像都会自动带上一个稳定的 id：
